InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: Represents a single inventoried material item for logistics return labels and Excel inventory export.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this material record.

pedido.description: Order number (Pedido) of the returned material.

palete.description: Pallet number where the material is located (used in Excel inventory).

dataInventario.description: Date when the material was inventoried (formatted DD/MM/YYYY).

batchId.description: Identifier of the batch ('active' for current list or batch ID for archived history).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was last updated.

InventoryBatch.title: InventoryBatch
InventoryBatch.description: Represents a saved inventory history batch header.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this batch.

title.description: Descriptive name or label for the saved inventory batch.

batchDate.description: Formatted date of the inventory batch (DD/MM/YYYY).

totalItems.description: Total number of material items recorded in this batch.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the batch was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the batch was last updated.

/inventoryItems/{itemId}.description: Stores individual material items for active workspace and saved inventory history batches.

/inventoryBatches/{batchId}.description: Stores saved inventory batch metadata for cross-device history access.
